name: Starwon Enterprises
summary: Perth ISP 'Starwon Internet' (starwon.com.au); dialup, pricing/status/support portal; WAIA WAIX-class member; absorbed into the Perth ispX (formed July 2004 with Starwon, Karratha Internet and Netserv Connect) (AUSTRALIAN INTERNET PTY LTD, ACN 089 479 836).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of starwon.com.au Dec 1996.

Absorbed into the Perth ispX, formed early July 2004 from Starwon Internet, Karratha Internet and Netserv Connect. The Starwon-branded homepage survived to ~2016 and the domain became Planet Ozi by Sep 2017 - the domain-level death, per proposal; retail content had thinned to a splash years earlier.

refs.label: Branded homepage (admittedly a thin splash since ~2008) still in place into 2016; same content in Feb 2012.
By 12 Sep 2017 the domain served the Planet Ozi homepage - same umbrella consolidation as RegionalConnect that month.
Domain 403s by Dec 2021; the reported 2004 ispX absorption remains unverified in press and the branded site demonstrably outlived it.
